prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: one existing installed Feudal Lord Simulator game image; non-destructive Wave41 revision.
Input1 is the immutable geometry reference. Edit this image, do not design a different asset.
Remove the cyan/teal lower-edge contamination completely. Use the adjacent warm dark oak shadow.
Unify wooden planks with the project bridge SW/NW-B reference: warm weathered oak grain, subtle worn corners, painterly surface. Do not add/remove/move any plank, support, shore earth or fastener.
ART_BIBLE_v2: soft hand-painted prerender, muted southern English1300-1450 material palette, upper-left world lighting, no black cartoon outline, no added text/watermark.
Maintain EXACT original canvas aspect 256:192, original transparent padding, anchor/pivot, ground contact, silhouette, perspective and occupied bounds. Do not crop, recenter or rotate. Output exactly one image; no comparison sheet.
Genuine transparent background. All originally empty regions remain transparent.
Input2 and Input3 are material/brushwork references ONLY. Keep Input1's exact perspective, outline, transparent margins, each plank seam and support positions. Render at the same 4:3 canvas aspect. Do not copy the geometry of Input2/3. Remove cyan edge tint; do not remove the edge itself.

inspection.columns: original / generated registered before original-alpha / final
inspection.findings: Warm oak grain and worn surfaces improved; original plank count, broad layout and direction retained. Cyan lower rim removed on 01/02.
inspection.geometry: Final canvas and all original alpha values are pixel-exact. Generated raw silhouette drift was explicitly registered and masked; raw is not geometry-perfect. Internal material/seam shading is not pixel-identical to source.
inspection.remaining_risk: Internal seam shading and support bevels vary slightly; verify actual adjoining bridge/fence sockets before installation.

processing.method: generated alpha bbox registered by affine crop+single Lanczos resize into original alpha bbox; original alpha reapplied pixel-exact; generated RGB extended up to 8px into uncovered original edge. No original geometry rescale. Explicit registration and pre-alpha proof retained.
